q: Obwana bwa Catherine Booth bwali butya?
a: Yazaalibwa nga Catherine Mumford e Ashbourne, mu Derbyshire, nga 17 Januwali 1829, era yali muwala omuwombeefu, eyayagalanga ennyo ebitabo, ow'omutima omulungi, eyakulira mu maka aga Kimesodisiti aga Kiwesule agaali gatya Katonda; era kigambibwa nti yali asomye Bayibuli yonna emirundi munaana nga tannaweza myaka kkumi n'ebiri. Teyali wa maanyi mu mubiri n'akatono: obulwadde obuzibu obw'omugongo bwamuzza eka okuva mu ssomero okumala emyaka esatu, egisinga ng'agalamidde ku mugongo. Mu kifo ky'okumala obwereere ekiseera ekyo eky'okusibibwa, yakijjuza Ebyawandiikibwa, eby'okusinza, n'obulamu bw'abo abaatya Katonda, ne kisenge kye eky'obulwadde ne kifuuka ekifo omwakolerwa omuyivu w'eby'okusinza eyeeyigiriza kumpi yekka.

q: Catherine Booth ddala yakkiriza nti abakazi balina eddembe okubuulira?
a: Yee, era obukakafu obwo yabutuukako okuva mu Byawandiikibwa byennyini, nga wakyaliyo ekiseera kinene nga tannaba kuguma kubukolerako. Empaka z'olupapula lw'amawulire bwe zaakuruka ku nsonga eyo, yaziddamu mu 1859 n'akatabo, "Female Ministry: Woman's Right to Preach the Gospel", ng'akwata kimu kimu ebitundu ebyakozesebwanga okusirisa abakazi era ng'awakanya nti byali bisomeddwa bubi. Okuwakana kwe kwali kwesigamye ku nsonga emu ennyangu: okuva Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe yawa omukisa bwe kityo mu lwatu emirimu gy'abakazi abeewaayo, ekiragiro ekibagaana tekiyinza kuba kituufu, kubanga "ekigambo n'Omwoyo tebiyinza kuwakanya."

q: Catherine Booth yennyini yatandika atya okubuulira?
a: Okumala emyaka yalwanirira okuyitibwa kw'abakazi abalala ng'awakanya okuyitibwa kwe ye, okutuusa ku Ssande ya Pentekoote mu 1860 mu kkanisa e Gateshead. Ng'atudde mu kkuŋŋaaniro, ng'anakuwadde era nga talina kye asuubira, yawulira Omwoyo ng'amunyigiriza okugondera kwennyini kwe yali akubirizza abalala; n'agolokoka, n'aserengeta mu kkubo ery'ekkanisa, era bba eyeewuunya yasobola kwokka okugamba nti, "Mukyala wange omwagalwa ayagala okwogera," n'atuula. Yayatula obujeemu bwe obw'ekiseera ekiwanvu obw'okuba, nga bwe yakyogera, "omusiru ku lwa Kristo," era teyaddayo nnyuma nate. "Okwatula okwo okw'amazima," yafumiitiriza oluvannyuma, "kwakola kiri emyaka amakumi abiri egy'okubuulira gye zitandisobodde kutuukiriza."

q: Obufumbo bwe ne William Booth bwali butya?
a: Catherine yasisinkana William Booth, omuweereza omuvubuka ow'Ekimesodisiti eyalina obunyiikivu obw'amaanyi obw'okubuulira Enjiri, mu 1852, era baafumbiriganwa mu 1855. Obufumbo bwabwe bwali bwa kussa kimu okw'amazima mu nzikiriza, Catherine ng'amuteesezaako mu nsonga z'eby'okusinza n'enteekateeka okuva ku lubereberye, era bangi basalidde omusango nti obulungi bw'amagezi ge bwakola nga bwe kimu n'omuliro gwe mu kubumba omulimu ogwaddirira. Tebaakkaanyanga bulijjo amangu ago, okusingira ddala ku buweereza bw'abakazi, naye ku bigendererwa ebinene eby'obulamu bwabwe baali bumu ddala.

q: Lwaki Catherine Booth ayitibwa "Maama w'Eggye ery'Obulokozi"?
a: Wamu ne William yayamba okuzimba omulimu gw'omu buvanjuba bwa London ogwafuuka Obuweereza obw'Ekikristaayo, n'oluvannyuma, mu 1878, Eggye ery'Obulokozi, era obukumi n'obukumi bw'abantu ne bamuyita mu linnya limu lyokka nti "Maama w'Eggye." Yayamba okukola enjigiriza yalyo, yawandiika ekitundu ekinene eky'okuyigiriza kwalyo, era yafuula obwenkanya bw'abakazi mu buweereza etteeka erinywevu, ne kiba nti abakazi baasobola okuweereza ng'abaami era ng'ababuulizi okuva ku nnaku zaalyo ez'olubereberye ennyo, enkola eyali ejjeemu mu kiseera kyayo. Yali, mu ngeri yonna, maama waalyo, mu nzikiriza zaalyo nga bwe yali mu kuzaalibwa kwalyo.

q: Catherine Booth yali mubuulizi wa ngeri ki?
a: Yafuuka omu ku babuulizi abeewuunyisa okusinga ab'omulembe ogwo, ng'ajjuza ebizimbe ebisinga obunene mu Bungereza era ng'asika abawuliriza ab'emitendera gyonna, okuva ku baavu b'omu East End okutuuka ku bibinja eby'ekitiibwa eby'omu West End. Tewali kyajja mangu; ng'alina abaana abato ne ssente ntono, yeeteekerateekeranga ng'ayonsa omwana we, ng'awandiika ebirowoozo n'ekkalaamu, era yagaana buli kwefuula, ng'ayita "obukalubo" ekiziyiza ekikulu eky'amazima ag'omu ggulu. Yapima ebibala bye ng'ayita mu kusaba kwe okw'olubereberye, era omulundi gumu yawandiika nti: "Bulijjo nsanga engerageranya entuufu wakati w'ebibala n'omwoyo gw'okwegayirira gwe mbadde nnafuna edda."

q: Catherine Booth yeenyigira ne mu nsonga z'embeera z'abantu okwongera ku kubuulira?
a: Yee, kubanga okuva mu buwala bwe yali akkiriza nti Obukristaayo obusaanira erinnya eryo bulina okukyusa si mpisa zokka, wabula n'embeera abantu mwe babeera. Yawagira mu 1885 kaweefube w'obulongoofu, wamu ne Josephine Butler ne W. T. Stead, eyayamba okusitula emyaka egy'okukkiriza egy'abawala okuva ku kkumi n'esatu okutuuka ku kkumi na mukaaga, era yalwanyisa emirimu egy'okunyigirizibwa egy'abakazi abaakolanga mu makolero ga kibiriiti abaali bafuna obutwa okuva mu phosphorus eya kyenvu, obulwadde obwamanyibwa nga "phossy jaw." Omwaka ogwaddirira okufa kwe, Eggye ery'Obulokozi lyaggulawo ekkolero lyalyo ery'ebibiriiti nga likozesa phosphorus emmyufu etaliiko kabi era nga lisasula emisaala egisingako obwenkanya, ekibala ekyava butereevu mu kweraliikirira okwo.

q: Abaana ba ba Booth baatuuka ku ki?
a: Abaana munaana baazaalibwa eri William ne Catherine, era omu ku omu yabawaayo eri obuweereza bw'Eggye; abawerako ne bafuuka abakulembeze ab'amaanyi ku bubwe. Omwana waabwe omukulu, Bramwell Booth, olunaku olumu yandisikiddemu kitaawe ku bukulembeze bw'ekibiina ekyo. Okukuza amaka agandigenze mu maaso okukulembera omulimu mu nsi yonna kyali, gy'ali, kitundu ku kwewaayo kwe kumu okwamuteeka ku mimbari.

Okwongera ku katabo ke aka 1859 ku buweereza bw'abakazi, okubuulira kwe kwakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu bitabo nga "Aggressive Christianity", mwe yakubiririza abakkiriza okuleka eddiini enkakkamu era ey'ekitiibwa olw'omulimu omulamu ogw'okubuulira Enjiri n'okuzimba obuggya. Emitwe gye tegyakyukakyuka: Enjiri eri abantu bonna awatali kusosola ddaala, okuyitibwa kw'abakazi okwaweebwa Katonda, ekisa eky'ebikolwa eri abaavu ng'ekitayinza kwawukana ku kukkiriza okw'amazima, n'okuwakanya okutaliiko kisa eri obusuubuzi bw'omwenge. Okuwakana okunywevu okw'ekyawandiikibwa nga kugattiddwa ku kweraliikirira okwaka olw'abo ababonyaabonyezebwa kwamufuula omu ku maloboozi ag'Ekikristaayo agasinga obukulu ag'omulembe gwe.

q: Catherine Booth yayolekagana atya n'okufa kwe?
a: Mu Febwali 1888 yagenda yekka eri omukugu n'abuuza amazima; kyali kookolo w'amabeere, obulwadde bwe bumu bwe yali ajjanjabiramu nnyina, ng'emyaka egy'okubonaabona giri mu maaso. Yeebaza daktari, n'avuga okudda eka, era n'afukamira mu mmotoka okuwaayo eri Katonda omubiri gwe, amaka ge, n'omulimu gwe, ng'afuula ebigambo bisatu ekigambo kye eky'okugumira okubonaabona okuwanvu: "Olutalo luteekwa okugenda mu maaso." Yafa nga 4 Okitobba 1890 e Clacton-on-Sea, ng'alina emyaka nkaaga mu gumu, ng'amaze okusonga ku kyawandiikibwa "Ekisa kyange kikumala" era ng'awuluguma nti, "Kaakano! Weewaawo, Mukama, jjangu, Ayi jjangu!" Okuziika kwe kwasika ebibinja eby'amaanyi ennyo eby'abagagga n'abaavu, obujulizi obw'ekyo obulamu bwe bye bwategeeza eri eggwanga.
